findings.description: The new test comment restates the source comment at `merge-gate.service.ts` L1079-1081 almost point for point (ratchet and draft can throw, `claude -p` wait, target holds the sha, `pup status` reads merged); the `it(...)` title already carries the behavior, so the comment adds little, and the rationale will have to be maintained in two places.

The comment says "the target already holds the sha", which is false in PR mode (`req.openPr`). There the sha is only pushed and the target has not moved, as the ratchet comment says at L1122-1123. The ordering rationale still holds in PR mode, because the status is already `merged` and the PR is open. "the sha is already landed" or "already pushed or merged" would be accurate in both modes.

The finally-block comment "recorded even if the teardown threw, since the target already holds the pinned sha" has the same PR-mode imprecision as finding 2. It is otherwise still accurate after the reorder, because the teardown and the event record remain together in the `try`/`finally`. Not introduced by this diff.
